title: MontuPython v0.21.0: astronomical ephemerides for the ancient world
description:
MontuPython (mnṯw ꜥꜣpp(y)) is a Python package to compute astronomical ephemerides in the ancient world — thousands of years before the present. It was developed for ancient Egypt and applies equally to other sites of cultural and archaeoastronomical interest.

Version 0.21.0 removes SPICE from the active package (time conversions use NumPy and PyMeeus), centralizes historical dates via load_historical_dates(), adds an Egyptian calendar example notebook, introduces release-pipeline.sh, and includes MontuPython Desktop updates through 0.1.6. See WHATSNEW.md for full release notes.

Ephemeris calculations rely primarily on PyEphem, with support from PyMeeus and pyplanets.
